sottos-payload.note: Private Sottos Payload CMS MCP server. Requires Clerk OAuth through the MCP client login flow; API keys are not supported. OAuth opens https://sottos.ai/admin when an admin session exists, otherwise https://sottos.ai/sign-in. Expected tools: findPosts, createBlogDraft, updateBlogDraft, tags/categories/media find/update/create where safe, getBlogDraftContext for compact inventory and cover references, getMediaReferences for cover-image references, createMediaSourceUpload for signed source uploads, plus uploadMedia for normalized sourceUrl/base64 image uploads. OAuth supports refresh_token so clients can renew without repeated browser login. For production cover images, upload the original generated image through createMediaSourceUpload, then call uploadMedia with the returned sourceUrl. Low-resolution, downscaled, or recompressed derivatives are rejected. Draft tools force draft:true and _status:"draft". Users tools must not be exposed. Delete tools should normally stay disabled; if enabled later, clients must confirm before use and prefer draft/unpublish rollback paths.
